text:
Alex K: Quick sync — we need to finalize the metric schema for per-model/route SLO panels. Goals: P50/P95/P99 latency, TTFT, tokens/sec, and a simple error rate. Can runtime guarantee the tag set?

Maya P: Yes we want consistent tags: route_id, model_family, model_version, quantized=true/false, region. Also a boolean for cache_hit.

Sam R: Important: ingestion cost. If we emit per-request histograms with all tags at 100% sampling it's expensive. Propose 1% high-resolution sampling + aggregated counters at 100%.

Jordan T: For the Console UX we need a deterministic key to group panels: route_id + model_family is the primary grouping. Model_version should be a selector for rollouts/canaries.

Lina Console: UX ask — show TTFT and P95 on the top row, tokens/sec and P50 underneath, P99 collapsible. Also include a small timeline showing canary traffic split.

Alex K: Agree. We should lock metric names. Draft proposal: 
```
redwood.runtime.latency_seconds_bucket{route_id, model_family, model_version, quantized, region, cache_hit}
redwood.runtime.ttft_seconds_sum/count{route_id, model_family, model_version, region}
redwood.runtime.tokens_per_sec{route_id, model_family, model_version, region}
redwood.runtime.errors_total{route_id, model_family, model_version, error_class}
```

Maya P: Two notes: 1) `ttft` should include upstream routing time vs model inference time — we need two fields or tags (ttft_total, ttft_infer). 2) cache_hit tag alone might not tell prefix-cache vs kv-cache. Can we add cache_layer=prefix/kv/none?

Sam R: +1 on split TTFT. For sampling plan: emit full histograms for model inference time at 1% of requests; emit aggregated sums/counters for total TTFT and tokens/sec for all requests. We'll include an "emitter_version" tag so we can roll metric collectors.

Jordan T: How will dashboards compute P99 for telemetry-sampled histograms vs aggregated counters? We can't compute accurate quantiles from aggregated counters. UX decision: use sampled histograms for quantiles (show a confidence band) and fallback to 99th-percentile estimate from recent samples when histograms aren't available. Show a little info icon explaining sampling.

Lina Console: Good. We'll add a tooltip: "P95/P99 computed from sampled inference histograms — confidence depends on sample rate". Also add a toggle: show only routes with >= X req/s to avoid noise (default 1 req/s).

Maya P: Tag contract update: add `route_owner` and `customer_tier` (free/prod/enterprise) for dashboard filters. Also prefer `model_family` over `model` to avoid sprawl.

Alex K: Routing policies: when a request falls back to lower-tier model (cost fallback) we need a `routed_model` vs `requested_model` tag so we can measure quality/regression.

Sam R: We'll emit both. Also propose a metric to measure routing fallbacks: `redwood.routing.fallbacks_total{route_id, from_model, to_model}`.

InfraBot: deploy-bot: telemetry-emitter v1.12 rolled to staging at 2026-03-18T11:26:00Z.

Jordan T: Next steps: infra/runtime to finalize tags and emitter smoke tests by EOD Wed. Sam to produce sampling cost estimate. Lina to mock panel layout and share GIFs. Maya/Alex will review contract and produce final schema PR.

Alex K: Thanks — can everyone drop a quick ✅ when you ack?

Maya P: ✅
